title: [SOA] Restrict direct deletion of contact overrides
summary: The SOA Task Contact Override table restricts direct deletion by removing the inherent delete permission, while preserving legitimate deletions through validated code paths.
key_points: Inherent delete permission removed from table to prevent unauthorized direct deletion via RecordRef or similar mechanisms
Deletion still available through SOA Filters Impl codeunit which validates access before removing records
Insert, modify, read and contact-routing operations unchanged
No data migration or backward compatibility issues
quote: Deletion remains available through SOA Filters Impl., which validates access and has direct delete permission.
